text:
Mia: Heads up — the post-launch dashboard for last week's webinar is showing impressions +40% but MQLs flat. Feels wrong, opening thread to triage.
Sam: Ugh, I saw that metric too in the weekly KPI review. Link?
Mia: https://pulse.redwood/pulseboards/webinar-q3 -> look at cohort by utm_source, compare 9/12 vs 9/19
Alex: I can jump on this. Quick hypothesis: GA tagging change or our inbound routing drop. @Priya any deploys to the attribution pipeline yesterday?
Priya: No deploys on attribution. We did push an email cadence update at 10:12pm but shouldn't affect UTM capture.
Jordan: The routing service logged a spike of 502s around 02:00 UTC, might have dropped some leads from Pardot -> API retry backoff could explain missing MQLs.
DashboardBot: data-refresh: webhook run complete (09/19 02:15 UTC) | rows processed: 24,102 | anomalies: 1 (routing_errors)
Alex: can someone paste the quick SQL to check ingestion counts?
Sam: ```SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) as day, count(*) as leads FROM inbound_leads WHERE created_at BETWEEN '2025-09-12' AND '2025-09-20' GROUP BY day ORDER BY day;```
Mia: ran that — shows a ~28% drop on 9/19 vs prior week, but impressions and click data from ads still look normal.
Priya: checking Pardot logs now, attaching snippet — session_id 9f3a... had 429s from our collector at 02:03.
Jordan: that aligns with the routing 502s we saw. Looks like collector->router retries exhausted and we silently dropped records.
Alex: Ok ops action: (1) rollback the collector config that introduced stricter concurrency (deployed 02:00) (2) reprocess stored webhook backlog for 02:00-03:00 window (3) mark KPI note for weekly review. @Sam can you add to the KPI agenda?
Sam: added to Friday weekly KPI doc under "post-launch anomalies" and flagged for A/B messaging cohort check. :white_check_mark:
Mia: Also, let's not jump to attribution change; keep messaging iteration separate. We'll re-run the dashboard after replay and confirm MQL delta.
Priya: starting replay job now, ETA ~18m. Will post when done.
DashboardBot: replay-job: started id=rbk-2025-09-19-02, expected rows: 3,200
Mia: thanks all. If replay restores counts we call it an ingestion incident and note the impact on the launch narrative. If not, we escalate to attribution team.
Priya: replay complete — restored ~2,940 rows. Dashboard now shows MQLs back to expected range.
Alex: great. Can we add a short blurb to the launch story: "temporary ingestion loss 02:00-03:00 UTC reduced recorded MQLs; corrected by replay; no product or creative issue detected"
Sam: done in launch postmortem doc. Linking here: https://docs.redwood/marketing/launch-q3/postmortem
Mia: perfect. Closing thread — thanks everyone :sparkles:
